say:2:1422302001:1.text: Hello, sir. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?
say:2:1422302001:1.male: Hello, sir. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?
say:2:1422302001:1.female: Hello, miss. I see that you're from outside the village like me. Can I ask you for a favor?

say:3:1422302002:1.text: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?
say:3:1422302002:1.source_cn: 能不能回村里帮我看看，我的妻子和女儿过得好不好……
say:3:1422302002:1.male: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?
say:3:1422302002:1.female: Can you go to the village and help me check if my wife and daughter are doing well...?

say:4:1422302003:1.text: Aren't you originally from this village? Why don't you do it yourself instead of asking strangers to help you?
say:4:1422302003:1.source_cn: 诶？你原本就是这个村子的人吗？为什么要找陌生人去看呢？

say:5:1422302004:1.text: Because I don't want the villagers to know I'm back... Oh, don't get me wrong! I haven't done anything wrong!
say:5:1422302004:1.source_cn: 因为我不想让村里的人知道我回来了……别误会！我没干过什...

say:6:1422302005:1.text: It's just that I can't bear for them to see me... I can't face Freda and Tali...
say:6:1422302005:1.source_cn: 我只是没脸见人……我该怎么面对弗瑞达和塔莉……

say:7:1422302006:1.text: My name is Harge, and I'm a blacksmith. Three years ago, I left home and promised to make a lot of money, become famous, build a grand workshop, and then return home...
say:7:1422302006:1.source_cn: 我叫哈尔格，是个铁匠。三年前，我从家里出来的时候满口承...

say:8:1422302007:1.text: Freda and Tali were very supportive. They never wrote about their struggles at home in their letters, but I knew how tough life was for them here.
say:8:1422302007:1.source_cn: 弗瑞达和塔莉很支持我，虽然她们在信里从不说家里的困难，...

say:9:1422302008:1.text: In the end, I never earned a single copper, and I've come back empty-handed.
say:9:1422302008:1.source_cn: 结果我呢，一个子没赚到，兜里空空的就这样回来了！

say:10:1422302009:1.source_cn: 你不是说你的手艺很好吗？

say:11:1422302010:1.text: Well, yes and no. I went to Rustport first, and in the beginning, business was good, but later, the port closed. Everything became more expensive, and finally, my money ran out...
say:11:1422302010:1.source_cn: 我先去了锈锚港，刚开始生意还不错，可后来港口封闭了，所...

say:12:1422302011:1.text: After the port reopened, I went to Cedartown to join up with some friends who worked there, but everyone there was always working on those ice sculptures. No one was interested in my smithing skills.
say:12:1422302011:1.source_cn: 港口解封后，我又去了雪松镇，想投奔在那干活的朋友，可那...

say:15:1422302012:1.text: Every time you went somewhere, it didn't work out...
say:15:1422302012:1.source_cn: 每次都刚好去了不适合做生意的地方呢……

say:16:1422302013:1.text: Now that I'm back home, I can't face them. How can I show my face around here? I'm just a useless idiot!
say:16:1422302013:1.source_cn: 可能我就是这么没用吧！如今回到村里我都不敢面对她们……...

say:19:1422302014:1.text: Chippy gets how you feel... Your wife's name is Freda, right? We'll go visit her for you!
say:19:1422302014:1.source_cn: 满满了解你的心情了……你的妻子叫弗瑞达是吗？我们会替你...

say:20:1422302015:1.text: Oh, thank you! My house is east of the village. I hope they're doing well...
say:20:1422302015:1.source_cn: 太感谢了！我家在村子东边，希望她们一切都好……
